name: Blueprint
bestFor: complex data-dense desktop web apps: analyst tools, IDE-like workbenches, ops dashboards
keyboard-heavy power-user tools (Hotkeys, Omnibar/Select, Tree, EditableText, PanelStack, ContextMenu)
dark-first or dual-theme internal tools (every shadow and colour has a dark counterpart)
apps needing a broad 5-step categorical palette for data and tagging (15 hues x 5)
avoidFor: mobile-first or touch-first products (30px default controls, desktop focus)
marketing and consumer brand surfaces (system font, small 14px type, utilitarian look)
teams wanting a modern semantic token API today (DTCG tokens are marked EXPERIMENTAL; BP7 OKLCH palette is preview only)

typography.notes: UI line-height 1.28581 (exactly 18px at 14px) so text centres in 30px controls with a centered-text() helper; 'running text' blocks switch to 1.5. Only two weights (400, 600). Headings h1-h6 hard-coded size/leading pairs. Icon font family sits inside the text stack so icons inherit text rendering.

color.model: hex (BP6); BP7 preview palette in OKLCH with hex fallback, 100-1000 steps

accents.extended hues (5 steps each): vermilion, rose, violet, indigo, cerulean, turquoise, forest, lime, gold, sepia (e.g. cerulean3 #147eb3, turquoise3 #00a396, gold3 #d1980b)

semantic.intent-primary: blue3 #2d72d2 (hover blue2, active blue1, disabled blue4)

color.darkMode: Class .bp6-dark on any container (scoped, not global), so dark and light panels can coexist on one screen. Every surface, text, divider and elevation shadow has a $pt-dark-* twin; dark shadows add inset white hairlines (rgba(255,255,255,.2) 1px + .5px highlights) to read edges on dark. Dark drop-shadow opacity is doubled (0.2 -> 0.4).
color.contrastNotes: Measured: primary blue3 #2d72d2 vs white 4.72:1; link blue2 #215db0 6.45:1; muted gray1 #5f6b7c 5.41:1; text #1c2127 on #f6f7f9 15.11:1; dark muted gray4 #abb3bf on dark-gray3 5.92:1. Warning intent uses black foreground because orange3 cannot carry white text. Forced-colours mode handled with system colour keywords (buttonborder).

spacing.base: 4px ($pt-spacing; v6.3 migrated components to 4px multiples) with legacy $pt-grid-size 10px
spacing.notes: Scale values are multiples used in source (spacing*0.5 ... *12.5); not a closed named scale. Button padding 4px 8px (small 0 8px, large 4px 16px); icon gap 8px; navbar height 50px.

shadows: elevation-3 (dialog, popover, tooltip): 0 0 0 1px rgba(17,20,24,.1), 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.1)
depth.borders: Borders are drawn as 0 0 0 1px box-shadows baked into every elevation, so edges and depth come from one token.

motion.notes: Single base duration 100ms; larger movements (drawer, tree caret, tab indicator) use 2x = 200ms. Token emphasis.motion-reduced exists in DTCG set.

modes: compact prop on Card, CardList, Callout, Divider and others (v6)

list: Forms (InputGroup, NumericInput, TextArea, FileInput, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, ControlGroup, FormGroup)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High: intent x state grid (rest/hover/active/disabled + foreground) for default/primary/success/warning/danger in both themes; minimal/outlined variants. Count = component directories in @blueprintjs/core 6.21.0 src/components (excludes datetime/select/table packages).

tokenArchitecture: Primarily Sass variables ($pt-*, $pt-dark-* twins) with palette in @blueprintjs/colors. An EXPERIMENTAL Style Dictionary / DTCG layer (--bp-*) has six categories: palette, intent (default/primary/success/warning/danger x rest/hover/active/disabled/foreground), surface (bg, border, shadow 0-4, spacing 4px, z-index 0-40, layer opacity .05), typography, iconography, emphasis (focus, transitions). Dark theme lives in tokens/themes/dark. BP7 preview palette defined in OKLCH 100-1000.
distinctiveness: Intent as the colour API (four intents applied uniformly to buttons, tags, callouts, inputs, text); scoped dark theme per container; elevation shadows that include the 1px edge; 15-hue x 5-step categorical palette; 30px desktop controls and 14/18 text tuned for density.
weaknesses: Token layer is experimental; most theming still via Sass variables
Mixed legacy 10px grid and new 4px spacing
Single 4px radius and system font give little brand expression
No published motion guidance beyond two curves and 100ms
takeaways: Use 'intent' (primary/success/warning/danger) as the one colour API every component accepts, with rest/hover/active/disabled/foreground per intent
Pick body line-height so text is an integer height (14 x 1.28581 = 18px) and centre it in control heights with a helper
Bake the 1px edge into every elevation shadow (0 0 0 1px) so borders and depth never disagree; in dark mode use inset white hairlines instead
Scope dark mode to a container class, not just the root, so mixed-theme panels are possible
One short base duration (100ms) and multiply for distance (x2) keeps desktop tools snappy
provenance: public-spec (@blueprintjs/core@6.21.0 src: common/_variables.scss, _color-aliases.scss, _typography.scss, design-tokens/tokens/*.tokens.json; @blueprintjs/colors@5.1.16; GitHub 6.x changelog); contrast ratios measured by computation
